N27.presentation: Fully human-looking divine figures. Seen options: a young woman with long straight lavender hair, blunt bangs, a silver circlet, blue eyes, a white dress and white feathered wings; a very old man with a long white beard and long white eyebrows in white layered robes; a woman with long pink hair, a white gown, a red flower necklace and a sheer teal sash; a boy with a long blonde braid, a laurel leaf in his hair, a white tunic and shorts, and a long striped scarf.
recipeProblems: 'halo-like ornament' (canon shows a circlet or laurel, no halos)
'blue' hair not seen; lavender and pink are
'luminous desk, floating menu, suspiciously bureaucratic ledger' (not in canon art; one goddess was a menu voice before taking a body, but no desk or ledger was seen)
N27.note: Lavender-haired goddess verified from anime screenshots on MyAnimeList (the official Black Summoner site is offline). The three gods verified from official character art published by Dengeki Online. The wings belong to her artificial angel body.

N28.presentation: Human women. One: very long silver-lavender hair with an upright cowlick and a sunflower ornament, blue eyes, a fitted white dress with high side slits, a gold capelet, cream sleeves and stockings, gold sandals. Two: very long red hair in a high ponytail with a striped orange headwrap, dark skin, yellow eyes, athletic build, black bikini top, short white frilled shorts, a long cream fringed scarf, orange gloves and leg wrap, barefoot.
recipeProblems: 'blonde, aqua, or rose hair' (anchors have silver-lavender and red hair; blonde and blue belong to two other goddesses in the same series)
'flowing divine dress' fits only the wind goddess; the fire goddess wears a bikini top, shorts and scarf
'ornamental ribbons' (not prominent in canon art)
offering tray and snack wrappers are gag props, not canon design
N28.note: Verified from official anime character art; Wikipedia confirms silver hair (wind goddess) and red hair with dark skin (fire goddess).
